verdict.rationale: Rollbar's homepage says it "points you to the code behind each error" (rollbar-docs-49), and Rollbar staff confirmed there is a GitHub source-code integration (rollbar-comm-3, rollbar-comm-4), so some repo connection and code linking exists. That support is thin, and the item Owner feature is a manually assigned Rollbar user, not repo-derived code owners. missing for 10: documented suspect-commit attribution, code-owners mapping from the repository, documented stack-frame-to-line linking on the default branch, and in-depth repo integration docs or hands-on corroboration.
